rule_audit.name: Project-based HUD termination notice
rule_audit.label: Project-based HUD termination notice (24 C.F.R. § 247.4)
rule_audit.summary: A covered project-based tenancy termination notice must state the termination date, sufficiently specific reasons, the ten-day discussion right, and the right to defend in a judicial eviction; nonpayment notices have added accounting content.
rule_audit.source: 24 C.F.R. § 247.4; HUD Handbook 4350.3 REV-1 ¶ 8-13.B; Iskin (6th ed. 2022), §§ III.C-D
rule_audit.excerpt: e lease clause governing nonpayment terminations requires a 30-day notice period (Exhibit A). The notice was served on February 10, 2023 (Exhibit B). Argument The termination notice must comply with 24 C.F.R. § 247.4. The termination notice did not quote or contain any advisement regarding a right to discuss the termination within ten days. The notice correctly identified the covered program as project-based Section 8 and stated the termination date as March 17, 2023. It provided specific rea
